installCommand: node -v && npm -v && echo NODE_ENV=$NODE_ENV workspaces=$(npm config get workspaces) omit=$(npm config get omit) && pwd && ls -a && npm ci --include-workspace-root --workspaces && echo '--- installed ---' && ls node_modules && (test -d node_modules/zod && echo ZOD_OK || echo ZOD_MISSING)
buildCommand: npm run build --workspace @renew/shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
